description: This file defines constants, macros, and function prototypes related to Lua's garbage collector, including GC states, bit manipulation macros, and object marking strategies.

methods.name: luaC_separateudata
methods.description: Separates userdata from other objects for garbage collection.

methods.name: luaC_step
methods.description: Performs a step of the garbage collection process.

methods.name: luaC_fullgc
methods.description: Performs a full garbage collection cycle.

methods.name: luaC_link
methods.description: Links a GCObject into the GC list.

methods.name: luaC_linkupval
methods.description: Links an UpVal object into the GC list.

methods.name: luaC_barrierback
methods.description: Backward barrier for the garbage collector.
